text: So they hid by a dam, and waited for a thousand emus to walk right up to them. It was perfect. And then, the gun jammed.
Now they tied a gun to a truck, and chased them. The truck couldn't catch up. And it bounced so hard, nobody could fire a single shot.
By now, every group of emus had a lookout. One tall bird stood guard while the others ate, and warned them when the army was coming.
Six days later, two and a half thousand bullets were gone, and the farms were still full of emus.
The official report said the men had suffered no casualties. Except for their dignity.
In the end, the army went home, and the farmers tried something else.
The army thought it was a war. The emus thought it was lunch.
